title: Agent Smith Configuration
description: Schema for agentsmith.yml (and agentsmith.example.yml): top-level named catalogs for agents, connections, repos and trackers; projects reference catalog entries by name. Every object closes its properties, so a misspelt key is reported here — the loader itself ignores keys it does not know.

agents.description: Catalog of AI agents. Each key is a name referenced by projects.

connections.description: p0281a: catalog of git-host connections. Repos are DISCOVERED under a connection via the provider API; a project selects them with connection/glob (e.g. 'acme/Sample.App.*', '!acme/Sample.App.Ui.Tests') instead of enumerating each repo.

repos.description: Catalog of source repositories (legacy / escape hatch for a single non-discoverable repo). Prefer connections + connection/glob references.

trackers.description: Catalog of issue/work-item trackers. Each key is a name referenced by projects.

pipeline_triggers.description: Global map of label/tag string to pipeline name. Project-level trigger blocks fall back to this when their pipeline_from_label is omitted.

projects.description: Per-project configuration. Each project references catalog entries by name plus declares its own trigger blocks.

mcp_servers.description: The configuration studio's MCP server catalog. Each key is a server name.

design_sources.description: Design tools projects read designs from. Each key is a source name; projects list the names under design_sources.

secrets.description: Named secrets other entries reference by name (auth: github_token). A value is usually an ${ENV_VAR} placeholder.

registries.description: Private package feeds the agent authenticates against inside a sandbox (get_artifact_credentials).

primary_provider.description: The default agent provider when a project names none.

skills.description: Skill catalog source. Normally unset: the server runs the catalog embedded in its image.

source.description: How the catalog is resolved. Unset: path when path is set, url when url is set, a pinned release when version is set, otherwise the catalog embedded in the server image.

version.description: Release tag of the skills repository to pull (source: default).

path.description: A mounted directory holding a skills/ subdirectory (source: path).

sha256.description: Optional checksum a downloaded tarball must match.

overlay.description: A directory whose skills are layered on top of whatever the source resolved.

cache_dir.description: Where downloaded catalogs are extracted. Default $XDG_CACHE_HOME/agentsmith/skills, then ~/.cache/agentsmith/skills.

max_parallel_jobs.description: Pipeline runs a consumer executes at once. Default 4.

consume_block_seconds.description: How long one queue read blocks. Default 5.

shutdown_grace_seconds.description: How long a stopping consumer waits for its runs. Default 30.

redis_retry_interval_seconds.description: Retry cadence while Redis is configured but unreachable. Default 30.

limits.description: Hard limits for the agentic loops.

max_sub_agents_per_run.description: Sub-agents one run may spawn. Default 20. 0 takes spawn_agents off every run's master.

max_sub_agents_per_dialog_turn.description: Sub-agents one design turn may spawn. Default 4. 0 takes spawn_agents off the design surface.

max_dialog_sub_agent_loop_iterations.description: The loop ceiling of a design turn's child. Default 20.

pipeline_storage.description: Retired 2026-10-02 and ignored: nothing stores in-flight run artifacts in Redis any more. Declared only so an older file still validates; the server reports it as a retired key. Delete it.

enforce.description: Refuse a pipeline whose commands read data no earlier command wrote, instead of warning. Default false.

pipeline_cost_cap.description: Per-run cost cap. When a run crosses it, the remaining model calls are skipped and the run delivers what it has. Default $5 / 500000 tokens.

per_tier.description: Complexity tier (Trivial, Small, Medium, Large) -> the cap a run of that estimated size may be raised to. Defaults $1/$2/$8/$25.

deployment.description: Single deployment-wide image pin feeding the sandbox-agent image. Left unset, the sandbox agent's tag is derived from the running server's release.

sandbox.description: Process-wide sandbox defaults (agent image pin, timeouts, the supply-chain boundary, the pull credential). Per-project `sandbox:` blocks override the per-project subset field-by-field; the boundary settings are global only.

agent_registry.description: Registry the sandbox agent image is pulled from.

agent_version.description: Sandbox agent image tag. Unset: derived from the running server's release (a deliberate pin is reported as an advisory finding).

step_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-time cap of one sandbox step. Default 900.

run_command_timeout_seconds.description: Default timeout of a run_command that names none. Default 300.

max_concurrent_sandboxes.description: Docker backend only: sandbox containers admitted at once on one host. Unset falls back to SANDBOX_MAX_CONCURRENT; 0 is unbounded.

hold_seconds.description: How long a design conversation keeps a source-scope sandbox alive between its turns, so the next turn reads the repository it already has instead of cloning again. Default 180. 0 holds nothing. Per-project projects.<name>.sandbox.hold_seconds overrides this. It governs the DESIGN DIALOG only — a pipeline run's sandboxes are transient by design and are torn down when the run ends.

allowed_registries.description: Registry prefixes a sandbox toolchain image may come from (mcr.microsoft.com/, ghcr.io/, a mirror host). Empty: the built-in default.

allow_docker_hub_library.description: Whether Docker Hub official images (node:20-bookworm) are trusted. Unset: trusted while no registry is named, refused once one is.

browser.description: 2026-10-01-283de: the browser sandbox render_reference spawns (Playwright Chromium, a tool runtime of its own). Default requests 500m / 1Gi, limits 2 CPU / 2Gi.

image_pull_secrets.description: 2026-08-31-46d7: names of operator-created Kubernetes image pull secrets the sandbox pod references, so an image that only exists in a credentialed registry is pullable without patching the namespace's default service account out of band. Rendered at pod level, covering the init container and the toolchain container. Kubernetes only — the Docker backend carries no pull credential and says so when a pull fails. Names are declared, never verified: agent-smith deliberately holds no read access to the namespace's secrets.

orchestrator.description: Run limits. Every run executes in the server; its sandboxes are the only pods it starts.

max_run_wall_time_seconds.description: A run older than this is cancelled. Default 1800.

dialogue.description: How a run waits for a person, and where that person answers.

hot_wait_seconds.description: How long a question is awaited in memory before an eligible run checkpoints and parks. Default 600.

approval_timeout_seconds.description: When a parked approval question times out, its default answer (reject) applies. Default 259200 (3 days).

dashboard_url.description: This deployment's dashboard address. A ticket comment that asks a question links to the run's page here; unset, it carries no link.

persistence.description: SERVER only, bootstrap: the relational store. Read from this file (or the environment) before the database exists, so it is never stored in it.

connection_string.description: The credential is part of it; a ${name} placeholder inside it is expanded by nothing. AGENTSMITH_PERSISTENCE_PROVIDER + AGENTSMITH_PERSISTENCE_CONNECTION replace the whole block.

auth.description: p0503b: the single OIDC authority a bearer token is validated against, and the switch that lets the permission a route declares refuse a caller. Bootstrap-only — read from this file and from AGENTSMITH_AUTH_* before the config store exists, and never stored in it, so an export can never emit a block the installation does not have. p0503d: it also says how the directory's claims become roles — the identity provider decides WHO holds a role, this block decides what a role MEANS.

authority.description: The OIDC issuer. Absent means nothing authenticates.

audience.description: The audience a token must carry. Absent means the audience is not checked.

enforce.description: Whether a missing permission refuses the call. With an authority configured and this off, a presented token is still validated and no route is refused.

role_claim.description: p0503d: the claim carrying role NAMES, read verbatim. A directory that NESTS its roles (realm roles under realm_access.roles) cannot be addressed by a flat claim name at all; map its groups instead.

group_claim.description: p0503d: the claim carrying group values, mapped onto roles by group_roles. Group values compare exactly, because they are opaque identifiers; a group path's leading slash is normalised away.

name_claim.description: p0503d: the claim a caller is NAMED by, on the identity page and in a config change's attribution. sub is opaque but always present; preferred_username or upn read better.

group_roles.description: p0503d: group value -> the roles holding it grants. A caller in two mapped groups holds the union of both bundles.

roles.description: p0503d: roles this installation adds to the built-in admin/operator/reader, as bundles over the permission catalog. Additive: a name colliding with a built-in role does not replace it, and a permission the catalog does not contain is dropped rather than granted.

role_mapping.description: What a role name means here. Normally edited on the dashboard's Access page; the file form is what an export and an import carry.

role_claim.description: The claim carrying role names. Default roles.

group_claim.description: The claim carrying group values. Default groups.

group_roles.description: Group value -> the roles it grants.

roles.description: Roles this installation adds to the built-in three, as permission bundles.

person_grants.description: Roles granted to one person here, each against the claim it was written for.

observation_retention_days.description: How long an observed caller is kept. Default 90; 0 or less keeps them forever.

enabled.description: Record each run's conversation (every prompt, answer and tool result), not only its numbers. Default false. The AGENTSMITH_TRACE environment variable, when set, wins.

tool_runner.description: Bootstrap, file-only: how scanners (Nuclei, Spectral) are started. Read from this file at start, never stored in the database or carried by an import.

type.description: auto | docker | podman | process. auto picks the Docker socket, then Podman's, then local processes. Default auto.

socket.description: Container engine socket, when not the default.

images.description: Scanner images by tool (nuclei, spectral), overriding the built-in ones per key.

docker_hostname.description: How a container reaches the host. Default host.docker.internal.

agent.description: AI agent definition. Projects reference it by its catalog name.

type.description: The provider. anthropic and google are aliases of claude and gemini. external_worker answers through an external agent CLI.

model.description: The agent's own model. Every role under models: that names none inherits it (through primary).

endpoint.description: The provider host: an Azure OpenAI resource, an Ollama server, or — with type: openai — any OpenAI-compatible server (vLLM, LM Studio, a gateway). A role on another provider does not inherit it.

deployment.description: Azure OpenAI deployment of the agent's own model.

api_key_secret.description: Name of the ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE holding the key. With type: openai and an endpoint, the key never falls back to OPENAI_API_KEY; a named but empty variable is refused, and none named sends no real key.

network_timeout_seconds.description: Per-request LLM HTTP timeout (default 300). The SDK default is 100s; a large completion exceeds it and the run dies with 'A task was cancelled'.

checkpoint_push_min_interval_seconds.description: p0360: minimum seconds between mid-run checkpoint pushes of dirty repo sandboxes to the run branch (default 120; <= 0 disables). A killed run loses at most the work since the last checkpoint.

compaction.description: In-loop context compaction. It summarizes with the agent's summarization role.

threshold_iterations.description: Deprecated and ignored: compaction fires on token pressure only. A non-default value is warned about.

max_context_tokens_trigger_ratio.description: Compaction fires past this share of max_context_tokens. Default 0.7; 0 or less disables it.

catalog.description: The models this agent may call, by entry name. A role under models: picks one with use:, so two roles on one deployment are one entry.

models.description: Per-role model routing. A role names a catalog entry with use:, or states its model inline. No role has a built-in model: an unset primary is the agent's model, every other unset role is primary (code_map_generation is scout, then primary), with primary's max_tokens.

pricing.description: Prices for models the built-in table does not know.

models.description: Model id -> USD per million tokens.

rate_limit.description: Per-model throttle. Unset: the built-in budget for the provider.

supports_vision.description: Whether images are sent to the model. Default true.

worker_structured_result.description: external_worker only: whether the CLI is asked for a structured result.

repo.description: Source repository connection. type=local uses path; remote types use url.

auth.description: Name of the secrets: entry this repo authenticates with (API calls, clone, fetch, push). Empty is filled with the type's legacy secret at load; a local repo takes none.

host.description: 2026-10-02-5f89a: the GitLab instance base url when it is not the url's own host (a GitLab under a sub-path). Filled from GITLAB_URL at load when unset.

connection.description: p0281a: a git-host connection. Repos are discovered under it via the provider API. azure_devops needs organization+project; github needs owner; gitlab needs group. host overrides the cloud endpoint for self-hosted installs.

host.description: Optional API host override for self-hosted GitHub Enterprise / GitLab.

auth.description: Name of the secrets: entry this connection's discovery and repos authenticate with. Empty is filled with the type's legacy secret at load.

default_branch.description: Fallback branch used only until discovery reads each repo's real default branch.

tracker.description: Issue/work-item tracker connection. Open states, done status, close transition, and extra fields belong here when shared across projects.

auth.description: Name of the secrets: entry this tracker authenticates with. Empty is filled with the type's legacy secret at load.

email.description: 2026-10-02-5f89a, Jira only: the account the API token belongs to. Filled from the jira_email secret, else JIRA_EMAIL, when unset.

trigger_statuses.description: p0281b: tracker-owned run-trigger gate inherited by every project routed here; falls back to open_states when unset. A project trigger overrides it.

failed_status.description: p0281b: tracker-owned failed_status base; a project trigger overrides it.

needs_clarification_status.description: Where a run parks a ticket that needs an answer. Must sit outside trigger_statuses; a project trigger overrides it.

not_implementable_status.description: Where a not-implementable verdict parks a ticket. Unset: needs_clarification_status.

pipeline_from_label.description: p0281b: tracker-owned label->pipeline map; a project trigger overrides it, then the global pipeline_triggers map is the final fallback.

default_pipeline.description: What a ticket runs when no label matched. A project trigger overrides it.

zero_match_comment.description: When true (and the provider supports comments), posts a 'no agent-smith project matched this ticket' note on tickets whose ProjectResolver lookup returns zero matches. Default false. Single-tenant trackers can opt in for forensics; multi-tenant trackers should leave it off to avoid noise.

polling.description: p0140c: per-tracker polling cadence. Pollers run once per tracker (not per project). N projects sharing one tracker → one polling cycle. Omit when this tracker is webhook-only.

endpoints.description: Jira only: REST path overrides. Defaults target Jira Cloud v3; set only a path Atlassian moved (e.g. CHANGE-2046 removed /rest/api/3/search), so the fix is configuration, not a redeploy. '{id}' is replaced with the issue key; paths are relative to the tracker url.

work_item_kinds.description: Azure DevOps and Jira only: which native work-item/issue type each filed ROLE is created as. Keys are the filing roles work | bug | phase | chat (case-insensitive); an unknown key is warned about and ignored. A role that is not mapped creates what agent-smith created before this key existed (Task), so a tracker that declares nothing behaves exactly as before. The choice is per role because the roles carry identical labels and nothing but the call site can tell an approved cut's work ticket from a lone phase or a bug. The role `record` was removed with the slice records it filed; a config that still maps it validates and is warned about as an unknown role.

lifecycle_status_names.description: Jira only: lifecycle state -> native workflow status name. Non-empty switches that state to real workflow transitions.

label_names.description: What this board calls the labels agent-smith writes: the lifecycle states by name, and the approved-set stamp under approved-set.

project.description: Project entry. References agent/tracker/repos by catalog name. Trigger blocks stay on the project; per-platform trigger settings are project-specific even when two projects share a tracker.

repos.description: Repos this project operates on. Always a list, even when there is exactly one; p0140 runs them in parallel. Each item is one of: a repos: catalog name (legacy); a connection ref connection/name (p0285 EXACT — resolved STATICALLY from the connection's host/org/auth, NO discovery); a connection glob connection/pattern (p0281a — resolved via DISCOVERY, may over-match); or an object {repo, default_branch} that adds a per-repo default-branch override to any of those forms.

design_sources.description: Names from the design_sources: catalog this project may read designs from.

templates.description: What each context of this project is built after: another project's context in one of its repos.

pipeline.description: Deprecated p0140. Single-pipeline shorthand; use pipelines: instead. Still accepted as a one-entry equivalent.

pipelines.description: Pipelines this project hosts. Each entry is either a string (pipeline name, uses project defaults) or an object {name, agent?, skills_path?}. The agent/skills_path overrides are exact-replace lookups, not partial-merge.

resolution.description: p0281b: flat resolution shorthand { strategy-key: value } where key is one of tag|area_path|repo|to_address. Combined with the tracker's type it builds the effective trigger, so a project need not spell out a full per-platform trigger wrapper just to declare routing.

polling.description: Deprecated: polling belongs on the tracker (trackers.<name>.polling).

sandbox.description: Per-project sandbox overrides (toolchain image, resources, timeouts, credentials).

browser.description: 2026-10-01-283df: whether this project's runs may render in a browser sandbox. When enabled, render_reference joins the coding master and admission reserves a browser pod at sandbox.browser.resources. Default off.

hold_seconds.description: How long a design conversation in THIS project keeps a source-scope sandbox alive between its turns. Overrides sandbox.hold_seconds; default 180; 0 holds nothing. It governs the design dialog only — a pipeline run's sandboxes are transient by design.

images.description: p0245: per-language toolchain image overrides (slug → image), merged over the code-default table per key. Polyglot-safe; the whole-project toolchain_image still wins outright. Keys: dotnet, node, python, go, rust, etc.

secrets.description: p0272: credentials injected into the sandbox pod. Values come from operator-created Kubernetes Secrets — never from this file or context.yaml; only the references are sent to the pod spec.

env.description: Env vars sourced from a k8s Secret. Each value is 'secretName:key', e.g. SF_CLIENT_ID: 'sf-creds:client-id'.

files.description: Secret keys mounted read-only as files (e.g. a JWT key for `sf org login jwt --jwt-key-file`).

webhookTrigger.description: Trigger block shared by GitHub/GitLab/AzureDevOps. pipeline_from_label is optional; when omitted the global pipeline_triggers map applies. project_resolution is REQUIRED (p0140) — declares how the webhook handler picks this project out of all configured projects for an incoming ticket.

jiraTrigger.description: The Jira trigger: the shared trigger block plus the assignee a ticket is handed to.

oneOf.description: A repos: catalog name, or a connection ref: connection/name (EXACT — static, no discovery) or connection/pattern (glob — resolved via discovery).

repo.description: The repo reference (catalog name or connection/name or connection/pattern), same as the string form.

default_branch.description: p0285: per-repo default-branch override. Applies to an EXACT connection ref. Precedence: this override -> connection.default_branch -> the provider's real default at clone time. Use it for a repo whose default branch differs from its peers (e.g. a docs repo on main while code repos use develop).

consumes.description: The served interface this repo consumes.

oneOf.description: Pipeline name; uses project's default agent and skills_path.

agent.description: Optional override: pipeline runs with this agent instead of the project default. Exact-replace lookup into the agents catalog (no partial-merge).

skills_path.description: Optional override: this pipeline loads skills from a different path than the project default.

coding_principles_path.description: Optional override of the project's coding_principles_path for this pipeline.

projectResolution.description: Tells the webhook handler which agent-smith project owns an incoming ticket. With multi-tenant trackers (one ADO project hosting many sub-projects, one Jira install used by many teams) this declaration is mandatory — without it the handler has no way to route. Strategies: tag (label match on ticket), area_path (ADO AreaPath prefix match — supports both \ and /), repo (GitHub/GitLab source-repo URL match — requires project.repos to have exactly one entry), to_address (Email tracker only, see p0141).

value.description: Strategy-specific match value. tag: label string. area_path: hierarchical path (e.g. ContosoMain/Billing or ContosoMain\Billing); matching is prefix-based on the normalized backslash form, so ContosoMain\Billing matches both itself and ContosoMain\Billing\Invoicing. repo: repo URL or short name matched against the project's single repo's RepoConnection.Url. to_address: full email address.

catalogModel.description: One model the agent may call, declared once.

context_window_tokens.description: The input window the deployment accepts. Unset: nothing is derived from it.

provider_type.description: Answer on another provider than the agent's type.

endpoint.description: This model's own host. Unset: the agent's endpoint, when it runs on the agent's provider.

tier.description: The operator's word for the model. A role that decides structure (primary, planning, reasoning, context_generation, code_map_generation) on an entry marked fast is reported; an untiered entry never is.

modelAssignment.description: One role's model: a catalog entry named with use:, or the model stated inline.

use.description: The catalog entry this role answers with. Set, it wins: every inline field beside it is ignored.

model.description: The model id. A role without one is unset and inherits.

deployment.description: Azure OpenAI deployment for this role.

provider_type.description: Answer this role on another provider than the agent's type.

endpoint.description: This role's own host. Unset: the agent's endpoint, when the role runs on the agent's provider.

context_window_tokens.description: The input window the deployment behind this role accepts. Unset: nothing is derived from it.

auth.description: A secret NAME from secrets: holding the access token, never a value.
A secret NAME, never a value.

resourceLimits.description: Kubernetes quantities (250m, 1Gi). All-or-nothing: a partial block is not merged with the defaults.

context.description: The context OF THIS PROJECT the binding applies to.

context_repo.description: Which repo of this project that context belongs to, when two declare one name.

project.description: The project the template belongs to.

repo.description: A repo ref of that project.

template_context.description: The context inside the template this one is built after.

triggerFields.description: The properties every trigger block shares — mixed into webhookTrigger and jiraTrigger, each of which closes them.

failed_status.description: Where a failed run moves the ticket. Must sit outside trigger_statuses. Unset: done_status.

needs_clarification_status.description: Where a run parks a ticket that needs an answer. Must sit outside trigger_statuses.

not_implementable_status.description: Where a not-implementable verdict parks a ticket. Unset: needs_clarification_status.

in_progress_status.description: Where a parked ticket returns when its run resumes. Must sit outside trigger_statuses.

pr_trigger_label.description: 2026-09-25-d83b: the label an operator puts on a pull request to ask for a review. Omitted → only the historical "security-review" triggers; a word set here is recognised in addition to it, never instead of it.
